purpose: Diagnose why V35 cross-device clean-onset recall collapsed despite adequate held-out event support and controlled FPR.

source.reuse: V35 canonical network-only representation and frozen whole-device split

benign_domain_shift.feature_shift: absolute median shift relative to pooled train benign IQR, per feature/device and grouped by history operation and count-vs-fraction base channel
benign_domain_shift.domain_classifier: fixed logistic classifier distinguishing pooled train-device benign histories from V35 test-device benign histories; diagnostic only

attack_label_overlap.inventory: normalized annotation labels per V35 split
attack_label_overlap.test_breakdown: test annotated and evaluable clean-onset events whose label was seen vs unseen on train devices

interpretation_rules.strong_domain_shift: benign train-vs-test domain ROC-AUC >= 0.80 or median standardized feature shift >= 1.0
interpretation_rules.label_shift_material: at least 25% of evaluable V35 test events have labels absent from train-device annotations
interpretation_rules.next_representation_if_domain_shift: develop scale-free derivative/ratio-only device-invariant features using development devices only
interpretation_rules.next_protocol_if_label_shift: separate seen-label cross-device and unseen-label cross-device development claims; do not merge them into one recall number

v35_test_reuse_boundary: V35 test devices are now development diagnostics and are no longer untouched final-validation data after V35 results were inspected.
final_validation: locked; V36 cannot establish forecasting accuracy or support a final zero-day/pre-compromise claim
